Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring submission of digital copies of public employees' collective bargaining agreements.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to digital copies of public employees' collectivebargaining agreements; adding a new section to chapter 41.56 RCW;adding a new section to chapter 41.80 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 41.76 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 41.59 RCW; adding anew section to chapter 49.39 RCW; adding a new section to chapter28B.52 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 47.64 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 49.66 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 41.58RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.56 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The employer shall submit a digital copy of their collectivebargaining agreement to the commission within thirty days of theeffective date of the collective bargaining agreement.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.80 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The employer shall submit a digital copy of their collective p. 1 SSB 6250bargaining agreement to the commission within thirty days of theeffective date of the collective bargaining agreement.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.76 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The employer shall submit a digital copy of their collectivebargaining agreement to the commission within thirty days of theeffective date of the collective bargaining agreement.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.59 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The employer shall submit a digital copy of their collectivebargaining agreement to the commission within thirty days of theeffective date of the collective bargaining agreement.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.39 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The employer shall submit a digital copy of their collectivebargaining agreement to the commission within thirty days of theeffective date of the collective bargaining agreement.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.52 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Employers of academic employees under this chapter shall submit adigital copy of their collective bargaining agreement to the commissionwithin thirty days of the effective date of the collective bargainingagreement.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.64 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The employer shall submit a digital copy of their collectivebargaining agreement to the commission within thirty days of theeffective date of the collective bargaining agreement.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.66 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The employer shall submit a digital copy of their collectivebargaining agreement to the department within thirty days of the SSB 6250 p. 2 effective date of the collective bargaining agreement. The departmentshall maintain a web site that allows the public to view and downloadthe collective bargaining agreements submitted by employers pursuant tothis section. The collective bargaining agreements shall be availablein a uniform digital format. Expired collective bargaining agreementsshall be available on the web site for up to ten years followingexpiration.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.58 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The commission shall maintain a web site that allows the public toview and download the collective bargaining agreements submitted byemployers pursuant to sections 1 through 8 of this act. The collectivebargaining agreements shall be available in a uniform digital format.Expired collective bargaining agreements shall be available on the website for up to ten years following expiration.
